##[error]Failed to CreateArtifact: Unable to make request: ENOTFOUND
If you are using self-hosted runners, please make sure your runner has access to all GitHub endpoints: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/hosting-your-own-runners/managing-self-hosted-runners/about-self-hosted-runners#communication-between-self-hosted-runners-and-github
root_cause: The TensorFlow layer test suite itself completed successfully (2114 passed, 0 failed). The job was marked failed solely because the subsequent 'ababushk/upload-artifact' step could not resolve/reach the GitHub Actions artifact-service endpoint from the Windows self-hosted runner, raising a DNS 'ENOTFOUND' error. This is a transient network/runner-connectivity issue external to the test code and unrelated to the PR's actual changes (documentation/skills-only PR #38342).
reproduction_steps: N/A - this is an infrastructure/network connectivity failure on the self-hosted Windows runner reaching the GitHub Actions artifact backend; it cannot be reproduced by re-running test code locally. Re-running the workflow job would likely succeed if runner network connectivity is restored.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'TensorFlow Layer Tests' job; the underlying tests already passed and the failure is isolated to artifact upload.
Investigate self-hosted Windows runner network/DNS health and connectivity to GitHub's artifact service endpoints (see the linked self-hosted runner networking docs in the error message).
Consider adding 'continue-on-error: true' or a retry wrapper specifically to the 'Upload Test Results' artifact-upload step so transient upload failures do not fail an otherwise-passing test job.
Monitor whether this ENOTFOUND pattern recurs across other jobs/runners to distinguish a one-off blip from a systemic runner-pool networking issue.
prevention_strategies: Wrap non-critical post-test steps (artifact uploads, result publishing) with retry logic or 'continue-on-error' so transient network hiccups on self-hosted runners do not fail jobs whose actual test payload succeeded. Add runner-level network health checks/alerts for DNS resolution failures to GitHub endpoints.
historical_context: No prior investigations recorded in the CI Doctor Post-Commit database; this is the first entry for this failure signature.
